def count_banners(image_path):
    # Load the image and divide it into rows
    image = Image.open(image_path)

    # Initialize counters
    banner_count = 0

    # Iterate through all rows
    for row in rows:

        if "LUNCH & DINNER:" in row.text:

    return banner_count
